notes.note: Will continues his great season with 31 disposals and 8 marks and a goal.  He is having a great season and could be the target of an Ed Allan tag against the Pies this week.
Ashcroft had 40+ points in both the second and last quarters and had 39 disposals and a team high 7 clearances. He is now 120+ for each of his last three games.
Will was the best for the Lions with 32 disposals and 2 goals. He is still one of the best options if you need a midfield replacement.
Ashcroft was great with 30 touches a couple of goals and 7 marks. If you need to replace anyone in the mids then he is a perfect target.
Ashcroft had 7 clearances from his 35 disposals but his efficiency was down at 65%. WE can't expect those huge scores from him every week but don't panic on him.

Will was massive this week with 8 clearances 3 goals and 33 disposals to go with 7 marks. He is one that wanted the ball in his hands and he ran with it scoring plenty of points even in time on in the last when the game was won.
Despite three behinds he top scored from the Lions with his 32 disposals. Four over 100 in the last five now for Ashcroft.

Back to back huge games for Ashcroft as he top scored for the Lions again this week. 30 disposals 8 clearances and 7 tackles. He is hitting a great run of form so he may be targeted by coaches needing a reliable midfielder.
Will went huge this week with his 2 goals coming from 38 disposals and 10 marks. Just his second over 100 since round 8 though despite how big it was.
22 touches for Ashcroft but his efficiency was just 59% as he posted another score under 90 making it four in the last five games.
Ashcroft was one of just 3 Lions to reach triple figures this week after a couple of goals from his 22 disposals.
Second lowest of the year for Ashcroft and he hasn't had a score over 100 now in the last four either. 21 disposals at 66% for him this week.
24 touches for Will but just 79% efficiency and his lowest since round 5
23 touches for Ashcroft and his lowest in the last month. We shouldn't be concerned as he is still scoring but he will need to be upgraded over the byes.
Will didn't have a huge day as the Lions spread the points around with 12 players on 90 or more. He ended with 28 disposals and 9 marks but his efficiency let him down.
26 disposals and a goal but 3 frees against meant that he had his second under 100 in a row.
Ashcroft had Simpkin for company for much of the game and was held to 19 disposals and his lowest for the season.
Will Ashcroft had his own footy and it looks to be his midfield now. 36 disposals and a goal for his best for the season by far.
